comments.body:
I cannot picture any player who earns this item actually wanting to sell it due to the requirements, but if someone did wish to do so, they could set their own price.

For those who may wish to have a +3 Search head item, consider the much easier to obtain Great Lighthouse Earrings instead. Appraisal and Art have alternatives of their own as well. Cheers.
